documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Osprey Partners (fictional).
In this document "OPH" means Osprey Partners. Osprey Partners reports term years of 3 years for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports aggregate liability limit of $12.1m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Osprey Partners reports annual price escalator of 5% for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports annual fee of $4.2m for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025) on a reported basis. For Osprey Partners, the governing law is read as: English law, London-seated arbitration. For Osprey Partners, the renewal is: expires at the end of the initial term unless renewed in writing. The fiscal year of Osprey Partners ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Osprey Partners (fictional).
OPH reports term years of 2 years for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports liability cap of $11.2m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Osprey AB reports uptime commitment of 99% for FY2025. Osprey Partners reports approximately maximum service credit of 13% for FY2024. For Osprey Partners, the governing law is read as: Swedish law, Stockholm courts. For Osprey Partners, the renewal is: renews automatically for successive 12-month terms.

documents.title: Supplier summary memo
documents.text:
Supplier summary memo — Osprey Partners (fictional).
Osprey Partners reports annual price escalator of 5.5% for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports annual fee of $5.1m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. Osprey Ltd reports uptime commitment of 121.58% for FY2025. Osprey Partners reports maximum service credit of 13.5% for FY2024. "aggregate liability limit" has the same meaning as "liability cap".
